course.adab.title: Suban Pa ne Abrabɔ Pa Adesua
course.adab.subtitle: Suban pa ne abrabɔ pa firi Surah Al-Faatiha, Surah Lukman ne Surah Al-Hujuraat mu
course.adab.track: Kuran Nkyerɛase a ɛfa Asɛmti ho
course.adab.short_description: Adesua tiawa a ɛwɔ adesua mmiɛnsa a efi nwoma «Al-Mukhtasar fi Tafsir Al-Qur'an Al-Karim» mu: nokware som a ɛyɛ Allah nko ara de wɔ Al-Faatiha mu, nyansa wɔ Lukman mu, ne suban pa wɔ Nkɔmhyɛni no ﷺ anim wɔ Al-Hujuraat mu, ne ntease nsɛmmisa wɔ adesua biara akyi.
course.adab.description: Saa adesua yi ka Muslimni suban pa ne abrabɔ pa ho asɛm sɛnea Kuran Kronkron no mu Surah mmiɛnsa kyerɛ no, a nkyerɛase a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a efi nwoma «Al-Mukhtasar fi Tafsir Al-Qur'an Al-Karim» mu ka ho. Ɛfiri ase wɔ Surah Al-Faatiha a ɛkyerɛ sɛ yɛnsom Allah nko ara wɔ nokware mu na yɛnhwehwɛ mmoa mfi Ne nkyɛn nko ara; afei Surah Lukman mfitiaseɛ ne papayɛfoɔ a wɔnya mfasoɔ firi nyansa mu no su; afei Surah Al-Hujuraat mfitiaseɛ ne suban pa wɔ Allah ne Ne Somafoɔ no ﷺ anim, a ɛka sɛ yɛbrɛ yɛn nne ase wɔ n'anim ho. Adesua biara wɔ krataafa no akenkan, n'Aayaanom nkyerɛase ne ntease nsɛmmisa tiawa, na adesua no awieeɛ no nsɔhwɛ a etwa toɔ wɔ hɔ.
course.adab.lesson.1.title: Surah Al-Faatiha
course.adab.lesson.1.subtitle: Nokware som ma Allah nko ara · Aaya 1–7
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.text: Adɛn nti na wɔfrɛ Surah Al-Faatiha saa din yi?
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.a: Ɛfiri sɛ ɛno na wɔde bue Allah Nwoma no
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.b: Ɛfiri sɛ ɛno ne Surah a ɛbaa fam akyire koraa
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.c: Ɛfiri sɛ ɛno ne Surah a ɛware sene biara wɔ Kuran mu
course.adab.lesson.1.q2.text: Dɛn na «Yawm ad-Din» kyerɛ wɔ N'asɛm yi mu: {مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ}?
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.text: Ɛkwan tenenee a yɛsrɛ Allah sɛ ɔnkyerɛ yɛn so no ne dɛn?
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.a: Islam, ɛkwan pefee a ɛnni akyeakyea biara
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.b: Yɛn agyanom ne yɛn nananom kwan
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.c: Ɛkwan biara a nnipa dodoɔ no ara fa so
course.adab.lesson.2.title: Surah Lukman
course.adab.lesson.2.subtitle: Nyansa ne papayɛfoɔ su · Aaya 1–11
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.text: Ɛwɔ he na ɛyɛ Surah Lukman atirimpɔw no mu baako?
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.a: Ahyɛdeɛ sɛ yɛnni nyansa a ɛwɔ Kuran mu no akyi, ne kɔkɔbɔ sɛ yɛmmfa yɛn ani mfiri so
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.c: Ɔbodan mu nnipa no ho asɛm
course.adab.lesson.2.q2.text: Wɔ Surah Lukman mfitiaseɛ no, hwan na Allah yɛɛ Nwoma no Aayaanom akwankyerɛ ne ahummɔborɔ maa wɔn?
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.text: Sɛnea Aaya a ɛtɔ so nson no ka no, sɛ wɔkenkan Allah Aayaanom kyerɛ ɔhantanfoɔ no a, ɔyɛ dɛn?
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.c: Ɔdane n'akyi te sɛ nea wante
course.adab.lesson.3.title: Surah Al-Hujuraat
course.adab.lesson.3.subtitle: Suban pa wɔ Nkɔmhyɛni no ﷺ anim · Aaya 1–4
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.text: Ɛwɔ he na ɛyɛ Surah Al-Hujuraat atirimpɔw no mu baako?
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.a: Nkɔmhyɛfoɔ a wɔdii kan no ho nsɛm a wɔka
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.b: Tɛkrɛma no siesie ne ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ ankorankoro gyidie ne ɔmanfoɔ suban so ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.text: Suban pa bɛn na Surah Al-Hujuraat Aaya a edi kan no hyɛ?
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.a: Sɛ agyidiefoɔ no nni Allah ne Ne Somafoɔ no anim wɔ kasa anaa dwumadie mu
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.c: Nne a wɔma so wɔ Nkɔmhyɛni no ﷺ anim
course.adab.lesson.3.q3.text: Dɛn ne akatua a wɔn a wɔbrɛ wɔn nne ase wɔ Allah Somafoɔ no ﷺ anim no nya?
course.adab.lesson.3.q3.c: Bɔnefakyɛ ne akatua kɛseɛ wɔ hɔ ma wɔn
course.adab.quiz.title: Ntease nsɛmmisa
course.adab.exam.title: Nsɔhwɛ a etwa toɔ
course.adab.exam.q1.text: Sɛnea Basmala nkyerɛaseɛ kyerɛ no, din «Allah» aseɛ ne dɛn?
course.adab.exam.q1.a: Nea ɔfata sɛ wɔsom no nokware mu
course.adab.exam.q2.text: Wɔ N'asɛm {إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ} mu no, hwan nkyɛn na yɛhwehwɛ mmoa?
course.adab.exam.q3.text: Ɔkwan bɛn so na Allah kyerɛɛ papayɛfoɔ no su wɔ Surah Lukman mfitiaseɛ?
course.adab.exam.q3.b: Wɔfrɛ Salah, wɔtua Zakah, na wɔwɔ gyidie a ɛyɛ den wɔ Daakye Wiase (Akhirah) mu
course.adab.exam.q3.c: Wɔdane wɔn ani firi nyansa so
course.adab.exam.q4.text: Dɛn ho na Surah Al-Hujuraat Aaya a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bɔ kɔkɔ?
course.adab.exam.q4.a: Nne a wɔma so sene Nkɔmhyɛni no ﷺ nne
course.adab.exam.q5.text: Dɛn na saa adesua yi mu adesua mmiɛnsa no frɛ nnipa kɔ so?
course.adab.exam.q5.b: Suban pa wɔ Allah ne Ne Somafoɔ no anim, ne abrabɔ pa

chat.course.title: Suban Pa ne Abrabɔ Pa Adesua ho Nkɔmmɔbɔ
chat.course.m1: Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, akwaaba wɔ adesua no nkɔmmɔbɔ mu. Mommisa mo nsɛmmisa a ɛfa adesua no ho wɔ ha.
chat.course.m2: Nkaeɛ: momfiri ase wɔ Surah Al-Faatiha adesua no so, na afei mommua ne ntease nsɛmmisa no na adesua a ɛdi so no abue.
chat.support.title: Mfiridwuma ho Mmoa
chat.support.m1: Akwaaba wɔ Moddaker, ɛdeɛn na yɛbɛtumi ayɛ de aboa wo?
